newsitem.title: GHANA: Ghana November yr-on-yr inflation at 33.2 percent.
newsitem.headline: Ghana November yr-on-yr inflation at 33.2 percent.

text.p: Ghana's government statistical service issued the following updated price inflation figures:

NOTE: Consumer inflation in Ghana fell for the eleventh consecutive month, reflecting the central bank policy of maintaining high interest rates -- at 45 percent in November -- and high reserve requirements of commercial banks (57 percent) to mop up excess liquidity.
The downward trend in 1996 inflation is also largely attributed to improved supply of foodstuffs, according to the Bank of Ghana Quaterly Economic Bulletin.
But November prices showed an average increase of 2.9 percent, a setback on 0.6 percent in October.
The government's objective was to reduce year-on-year inflation to 20 percent by December 31, 1996.
In view of the traditional December price hikes, 3.5 percent in December 1994 and 3.8 percent in December 1995, end-of-year inflation is likely to be around 35 percent.
